title.zh-CN: 更有层次的磁盘扫描光效

items.zh-CN: 同心扫描增加蓝紫光晕、渐变拖尾和扇区受光，内外光点继续同步，扫描完成后平滑收束。
items.en: Concentric scans gain blue-violet glow, gradient trails and illuminated sector edges. Inner and outer lights stay synchronized, then settle smoothly when scanning finishes.

items.zh-CN: 移除空间图下方重复的未完成提示，扫描状态统一在顶部进度区显示，让结果区域更简洁。
items.en: Removed the duplicate partial-scan caption below the space chart. Scan status stays in the progress area above, keeping results uncluttered.
